item.description: CEBU CITY, Philippines — August 20, 2026 — Following close coordination with the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC), partner power suppliers, and the implementation of mitigation measures, Visayan Electric has successfully shielded its residential consumers from a multi-peso price spike in this month's billing cycle.
